name: bc3_contract_and_domain
requirement: the frozen 3D domain, heldout tangents, area vector, and exact contract must match

name: bc3_local_c0_and_predecessor_binding
requirement: the theorem must use the source-bound experiment-local exact C0 formulas; full-box clip/wrap margins are analytic and core samples are regression-only

name: bc3_dynamics_contraction_and_conventions
requirement: variable-alpha dynamics must have rho<=7/10, equilibrium init, right-endpoint sampling, and exact reverse

name: bc3_exact_factorization_and_covariance
requirement: F must be the frozen exterior derivative factorization with closure, covariance, and no response fit

name: bc3_directed_interval_nonzero_margins
requirement: directed rational interval enclosures must prove every heldout response component and density nonzero

name: bc3_geometry_rank1_and_alpha_fiber_separation
requirement: Omega must be alpha-independent rank-one while response changes across the alpha fiber

name: bc3_prediction_lock_and_heldout_split
requirement: the immutable prediction and distinct heldout center must pass the exact INIT->PREDICTION_LOCKED->ORACLE_RUN->VERIFIED sequence

name: bc3_response_oracle_firewall
requirement: the response oracle must receive no geometry, prediction, area, orientation label, outcome, or heldout fit

name: bc3_generic_ladder_and_nulls
requirement: the generic O(s/N) ladder must stay in-domain with sN increasing and exact scoped nulls/factor two

name: qp3_same_operator_projector_and_gap
requirement: experiment-local P+, H, eigenvalues, gap, and spectral projector must agree without claiming the old 2D builder

name: qp3_monopole_geometry
requirement: geometry must independently compute the ambient monopole curvature from the shared projector

name: qp3_kubo_sign_and_factor
requirement: +dH must give +Omega, -dH must give -Omega, and full antisymmetrization must equal twice half

name: qp3_rank3_centers_and_heldout
requirement: e1,e2,e3 two-form vectors must span rank three and predict heldout h density exactly one half

name: qp3_gauge_coordinate_closure_and_chern
requirement: the tensor must be gauge invariant, coordinate covariant, closed off the origin, and retain its Chern obstruction

name: qp3_constant_projector_and_nonscalar_refusals
requirement: constant projectors must be null and the declared nonscalar K must fail closure

name: ineligible_and_circular_control_matrix
requirement: every tautological, circular, auxiliary, fitted, and claim-inflating control must be refused

name: claim_ceiling_and_evidence_scope

observed.claim_ceiling: internal synthetic Benchmark-C kinetic-control derivation and experiment-local QP3 same-operator calibration only; not universal or full CWT, physical response, empirical evidence, or a general CGT-response alignment law

requirement: status, evidence, model-specific ceiling, immutable ownership, and dispositions must match the contract
